headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to more actively manage forests, rangelands, and other federal lands to lower wildfire risk.
what_it_does: This order tells federal agencies to take a more active approach to managing forests, rangelands, and other federal lands. The stated goals are to improve land conditions and reduce the risk of wildfires. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, targets, and deadlines in the order are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to step up management of federal forests, rangelands, and other lands to reduce wildfire risk.

who_it_affects.group: People who live near federal forests and rangelands
who_it_affects.how: They may see changes in how nearby federal lands are managed with the aim of lowering wildfire danger.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 21, 2018; specific implementation dates are not stated in the available material.
